players.product: inspection & metrology for HBM / 2.5D advanced packaging

quarterly_data.signal: 20-F customer concentration (customers not named): in 2025 one customer accounted for 11% of total revenues; in 2024 three customers accounted for 15%, 10% and 10% of total revenues; in 2023 one customer accounted for 15%. Camtek's customers are semiconductor manufacturers, among them OSATs, IDMs and wafer level packaging subcontractors, located throughout Asia, Europe and North America; as of December 31, 2025 its installed base was over 3,000 systems.
quarterly_data.figure: one customer 11% of 2025 total revenues (2024: 15%, 10%, 10%); installed base over 3,000 systems

quarterly_data.signal: 20-F capex: Camtek's capital expenditures during 2025 were approximately $22.5 million, mainly to increase its production capacity and to support R&D, operations and IT activities (building and leasehold improvements $9,326 thousand, machinery and equipment $8,511 thousand). Camtek says it relies on single source and limited source suppliers and subcontractors for a number of essential components and subsystems, has increased its inventories and production capacity, and to date has been able to obtain sufficient components to meet its needs in a timely manner.
